operational.semantics: How strongly the market values this card's treatment package relative to evidence-supported treatments in the appropriate Pokémon era or treatment regime, after adjusting for established non-treatment characteristics.

score_drift.classification: movement within gates is MARKET_MOVEMENT; a breached gate without a source/cohort/taxonomy explanation is MODEL_INSTABILITY

staleness.baseline_change: old run remains reproducible but is not latest-version eligible
staleness.material_new_set: MODEL_STALE after 30 days unless entry review completes

precision.storage: numeric(6,4) for score/effects and numeric(7,4) interval bounds
precision.api: one decimal scoreDisplay; full stored numeric score reserved for audit

cadence.approved_promotion: monthly after full validation; exceptional promotion after canonical taxonomy/universe change
cadence.reason: monthly checkpoints show stability, but no evidence supports daily promotion and daily prices would imply false responsiveness

operational.freshness: current market prestige as of a coordinated approved snapshot; hierarchical stabilization, not a temporal moving-average blend

constraints: score is null unless evidence_status AVAILABLE or SUPPORTED_WITH_HIGH_UNCERTAINTY

latest_approved_reader.name: latest_approved_treatment_market_prestige
latest_approved_reader.semantics: security-invoker read model selecting the greatest approved market_reference_date, then approved_at, only within the current non-stale methodology/baseline version; candidate/completed/rejected/revoked runs are invisible; explicit approval cannot be inferred from successful execution
latest_approved_reader.publication_atomicity: run and all score rows staged as candidate, validation finalized, then one transaction changes approval; partial writes never become visible

api.resolution: card -> canonical era -> frozen set-to-regime mapping where applicable -> normalized treatment key -> latest approved non-stale eligible row
tooltip_requirements: real-world scarcity and mechanics bundled with the treatment are part of the package
similar prestige can produce similar scores
unsupported evidence is unavailable, never estimated

new_set.initial_status: MODEL_STALE for affected universe pending review; its rows do not influence approved scores
gates: minimum 25 eligible cards and >=5 per treatment cell
new_set.regime: join only through structural ontology review; price behavior cannot create a regime

new_treatment.fallback: none; no V1, neighboring treatment, or cross-era borrowing

baseline.creation: created for a newly validated comparison universe or methodology major version
baseline.replacement: only after full historical backtest and explicit approval
baseline.versioning: replacement requires score-transform/baseline version bump; methodology bump if formula/estimand changes
baseline.new_treatments: enter against the frozen baseline after eligibility; do not re-center prior scores
baseline.history: every row retains baseline version and immutable parameters
